verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your love is devoted
Like a ring of solid gold
Like a vow that is tested
Like a covenant of old

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Your love is enduring
Through the winter rain
And beyond the horizon
With mercy for today

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Faithful You have been
And faithful You will be
You pledge Yourself to me
And it’s why I sing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Your praise will
Ever be on my lips
Ever be on my lips

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You Father the orphan
Your kindness makes us whole
You shoulder our weakness
And Your strength becomes our own

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You're making me like you
Clothing me in white
Bringing beauty from ashes
For You will have your bride

verse.name: p2
verse.lines:
Free of all her guilt
And rid of all her shame
And known by her true name
And it’s why I sing

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
Your praise will
Ever be on my lips
Ever be on my lips

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You will be praised
You will be praised
With angels and saints
We sing worthy are You Lord

verse.name: c3
verse.lines:
Your praise will
Ever be on my lips
Ever be on my lips
